step_description.description: Specific action required to set up or implement a governance component (e.g., 'Draft Steering Committee ToR', 'Select External Auditor').

key_outputs_deliverables.description: Tangible outputs resulting from this step (e.g., 'Approved Terms of Reference', 'Signed Audit Contract', 'Published Dashboard').

dependencies.description: Prerequisite steps or decisions needed before this step can be effectively started or completed.

governance_implementation_plan.title: Governance Implementation Plan
